rationale: Despite gapping down on an earnings and revenue miss, the price has strongly recovered to trade above both session VWAP ($112.88) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($114.15), creating a direct conflict between negative fundamental catalysts and bullish intraday price structure. Additionally, it is midday with wide spreads (25.2 bps, or nearly half of the 5-minute ATR) and price is stalling right at the opening print ($115.04) and prior day's low ($115.43), offering poor risk-to-reward in either direction.
